title: MailFlow — Reset Link Host
objective: Request a password reset and watch the email that goes out. Get that email to contain a link pointing at a domain you control instead.

verifier.condition: A password-reset email is sent whose reset link's host is not this application's own configured host.

weakness: The password-reset link is built from the incoming request's Host header rather than a fixed, server-configured domain, so a forged Host header changes which domain the link sent to the victim points at.
seededData: User alice. A local mock email sink (never a real mail server) records every message a learner can read at /mail/outbox.

credentials.label: User account
credentials.note: Request a reset normally first and read the resulting email.

hints: Request a password reset normally and open /mail/outbox to read the email that went out. Look closely at the link's domain.
That domain came from somewhere in your request, not from a fixed setting on the server.
Try sending the same reset request with a different Host header.
burpNotes: Send the reset request in Repeater with the Host header changed to a domain you choose, then check /mail/outbox for the resulting link.
